arguments.analyst: Round 3: observed leaders O1 (3.867), O2 (3.856), O3 (3.852); N144D/N144S edits recur in observed set (N144D appears in 5 observed combos, N144S in O3). Menu single-edit C08/C13 (3.351) look baseline; paired C designs cluster 3.55-3.63, so pairing of conservative class-matched edits is the testable lever. O9 (K41T:T43A, 3.698) supports N-terminal region tolerance to T43A.
arguments.hypothesis: Combining conservative/coarse-class-matched menu edits with observed-benign N-terminal or surface substitutions (e.g., T43A, N144D-like polar-uncharged changes) preserves or exceeds the ~3.7 log-brightness level of O3/O6/O9, whereas adding proline/glycine disruptive edits drops brightness to ~2.3-3.0.
